changelog:
v2.13.7 - Eye Care never blocks, plus system-wide dark mode

- Removed Broken Screen entirely. Its full-screen overlay was touchable and could sit above everything, which is the feature class that froze taps.
- Eye Care strength hard-capped at 50% so the tint can never be treated as an obscuring window that blocks touches.
- Peek Guard no longer adds a dim-behind layer, so two dims can never stack into a touch-blocking one.
- New Dark Mode with four stages: Light dark, Dark, Heavy dark, Deep dark. Dims the whole phone in every app, never touchable, and it stops Eye Care first so only one dim window exists at a time.
